clue.text: Nearly exact summary

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: exact means precise

explanation.surface: A summary that is almost word-for-word accurate.
explanation.definitionFit: A précis is a brief abstract of a longer text, a synonym for a summary.

clue.text: Fast car, one hidden by Rolls-Royce

indicators.note: something hidden by another is enclosed within it, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: an ace is a one in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A speedy car whose name is concealed beneath a luxury marque.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing car built for speed is known simply as a racer.

clue.text: It can be put on the back of a lorry once train is in motion

definitions.text: It can be put on the back of a lorry

indicators.note: in motion means the letters of these words are set moving into a new order

explanation.surface: A freight box is lifted onto a truck once the train starts moving.
explanation.definitionFit: A shipping container is the large metal box loaded onto lorries and trains.

clue.text: Be in a state of suppressed anger and keep just below boiling point

definitions.text: Be in a state of suppressed anger

explanation.surface: Someone seething quietly, like a pan kept off the boil.
explanation.definitionFit: To be quietly furious and to cook gently short of bubbling are both senses of the same verb.

clue.text: Tough guy's shell?

explanation.surface: Asking whether a tough guy is really a shell.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard nut of a person is a hard case, and a shell is literally a rigid casing.

clue.text: Dance performed with uncertainty?

parts.note: a dance whose name suggests dancers who keep pausing and wavering; it is a real ballroom dance with held steps

explanation.surface: A dance done by people who cannot make up their minds.
explanation.definitionFit: This ballroom dance takes its name from the pauses or held steps within the three-beat rhythm.

clue.text: Plan again to put Desmond in control

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: to reign is to rule or control
Des is the short form of the name Desmond

explanation.surface: Reorganising things so that a man called Desmond is in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: To redesign is to draw up a fresh scheme, planning something a second time.

clue.text: Complaint of the colonel in charge

explanation.surface: The commanding officer's grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: Colic is a painful ailment of the abdomen, and complaint here means an illness.

clue.text: Number of item in sports programme that had been witnessed outside

indicators.note: outside means the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: been witnessed means seen
each item in a sports programme is an event

explanation.surface: Counting an item on the sports card that people had already watched.
explanation.definitionFit: Seventeen is a whole number, one more than sixteen.

clue.text: Spent frugally or saved

explanation.surface: Money either spent carefully or kept aside.
explanation.definitionFit: To economise is both to use money sparingly and to make savings, so both senses fit the past tense.

clue.text: Full of energy, but no good making a come-back

indicators.note: making a come-back means the word for no good comes back to front

parts.note: evil means bad or no good

explanation.surface: Someone energetic who is a wrong 'un staging a return.
explanation.definitionFit: A live performer or wire is lively and charged with energy.

clue.text: Something needed in the preparation for war

definitions.text: Something needed in the preparation for war

parts.words: Something needed in the preparation for war
parts.note: a plain description of what an army must stockpile before fighting, namely weapons

explanation.surface: Listing what must be ready before fighting starts.
explanation.definitionFit: Weaponry and military equipment collectively make up a nation's armament.

clue.text: Time for another?

explanation.surface: Asking whether it is time for one more.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny unit of time shares its name with the word meaning one more, as in a second helping.

clue.text: Vegetable feast!

parts.note: read as a vegetable whose name, joined to the word feast, makes the old term for a works outing or party

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a meal of vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: A pulse such as the broad or runner kind is a vegetable, and with feast it forms a party word.

clue.text: Right mark endlessly placed under riddle is puzzling

indicators.note: in a down clue, placed under puts this piece below the riddle, so after it

parts.note: an enigma is a riddle

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the mark is lost

parts.note: a tick is the mark showing an answer is right

explanation.surface: A correct mark scrawled beneath a riddle is baffling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something enigmatic is mysterious and hard to work out.

clue.text: In concert to catch the girl

parts.note: to catch is to get
her refers to the girl

explanation.surface: At a concert, trying to win over a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means acting jointly, as one.

clue.text: Sensational article about running water

indicators.note: about means the first piece surrounds the second

parts.note: an article is an object or thing
a rill is a small stream of running water

explanation.surface: A newspaper feature about streams that is exciting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sensational gives a thrill, so it is exciting.

clue.text: Light ale three drunk

indicators.note: drunk means the letters of these words are tipsy and jumbled

explanation.surface: Three people drinking a light beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal describes something delicate and airy, extremely light.

clue.text: Leading lady has bitter exchange, nothing more in the words of the opera

indicators.note: leading picks the first letter of the word lady
exchange means the letters of bitter swap places

parts.note: O is the figure for nothing

explanation.surface: A diva has a sour row, and that is all, over an opera's text.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchange' rearranges BITTER into IBRETT, which sits between L and O.
explanation.definitionFit: A libretto is the text of an opera, written for setting to music.

clue.text: Phone, it shows if one is engaged

definitions.text: it shows if one is engaged

explanation.surface: A phone call announcing an engagement.
explanation.definitionFit: To call someone is to give them a buzz, and a betrothal is marked by a band on the finger.

clue.text: He aims not to be seen by the enemy

definitions.text: He aims not to be seen by the enemy

parts.words: He aims not to be seen by the enemy
parts.note: a hidden marksman who takes aim while staying concealed from the opposing side

explanation.surface: A soldier trying to stay out of enemy sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A concealed marksman who shoots from cover is a sharpshooter of this kind.

clue.text: Smear some of this mud generally in

indicators.note: some of means only a run of letters is taken from these words

explanation.surface: A dirty mark from this mud that gets in everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A smudge is a blurred dirty mark, a smear.

clue.text: Material that's dug up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: dug, as for coal, means mined

explanation.surface: Cloth that has been excavated.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is a hard-wearing cotton cloth used for jeans.

clue.text: Turn a girl has on a hoisting device

parts.note: to turn a handle is to wind it
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A young woman taking a turn on a winch.
explanation.definitionFit: A windlass is a winch for raising weights such as an anchor.

clue.text: Bird takes in one country youth

indicators.note: takes in means the bird encloses the other piece

parts.note: a swan is a bird
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A bird swallowing a young rustic.
explanation.definitionFit: A swain is a young man from the countryside, often a suitor in pastoral verse.

clue.text: Gun destroys nest

indicators.note: destroys means the word nest is wrecked and its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A firearm wrecking a bird's home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sten was a British submachine gun of the Second World War.

clue.text: I'll place it at random as it isn't quite round

indicators.note: at random means the letters of these words are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Placing something carelessly because it is not quite circular.
explanation.definitionFit: An ellipse is an oval, so an elliptical shape is a slightly squashed circle.

clue.text: Some choral highbrow music, a largo that Zoe initially made with excessive sentimentality

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the preceding words

explanation.surface: Zoe sings a slow, heavy choral piece far too sentimentally.
explanation.definitionFit: Schmaltz is mawkish, sugary emotion in music or writing.

clue.text: Redhead getting on showing violent anger

parts.note: the head, or first letter, of red is R
getting on means ageing, growing older

explanation.surface: A ginger-haired person, getting older, losing their temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone raging is furious, in a towering temper.
